The first screenshot displays a dark-themed hero page featuring a black hole visualization on the right. The left text column is clearly legible, with high-contrast typography that remains distinct and free from visual interference or overlapping elements. The layout successfully balances the complex graphic with readable content.

The second screenshot shows the gravitational lensing simulation canvas in an active state. Following user interaction, the lens mass is visibly displaced from the center of the coordinate system. This displacement has triggered noticeable gravitational distortion, warping the surrounding starfield and grid lines. The visual feedback confirms that the dragging functionality is working as intended, accurately simulating the physical principles of light deflection around a massive object.
